handout_name: Fallon Middle School Campus Map (official PDF)
handout_note: The handout at handout_url is the official schematic campus map from the Fallon website. It shows building shapes and numbered room-entry points per building (1 through 5 around each classroom cross). Share this link when users ask for 'the full map', a 'printable map', or need to see the numbered classroom entries that aren't labeled on the satellite image at map_url.
_source: Building positions were pinned on a Google Maps satellite screenshot of 3601 Kohnen Way (compass needle confirmed north-up) by the user manually marking each building with its letter; those pixel positions were then rendered onto the campus_map.png at map_url. Building names and classroom-room numbering come from the official FMS Campus Map PDF at handout_url. Cardinal directions below are TRUE cardinal.

campus_context.orientation: North is up on the campus_map.png (Google Maps orientation verified by the compass needle; a compass rose is drawn in the top-left corner of the image).

boundary_streets.north: S Dublin Ranch Drive runs along the north edge of the Fallon campus.
boundary_streets.south: Kohnen Way runs along the south edge; the main parking lot and parent drop-off sit between Kohnen Way and the school buildings.
boundary_streets.east: Grafton Street runs along the east edge.
boundary_streets.west: The athletic fields form the west edge of campus; residential streets lie further west.

zones.west: Athletic fields: a grass field in the north-west and a dirt/track field in the south-west, plus Building N (Gymnasium / Dance Room) on the west edge next to the fields.
zones.center_and_east: The main classroom horseshoe wraps around the central Courtyard. Classroom buildings A, B, C, D, E (north/upper arc) and F, G, H, J (south/east arc) form the outer ring; portable classroom groups P (north side) and Q (east side) sit against the outer edges of the arc.
zones.center_south: The Administration (K) and Media Center (L) fan buildings sit south of the Courtyard, with Building M (Multipurpose Room / Cafeteria) just to the west of K.
zones.south: Main parking lot and parent drop-off along Kohnen Way, between the school complex and the street.

A.name: Classroom Building A
A.position: Upper-west side of the horseshoe arc, between Building B (north) and Building M (south-west). Each wing of A is numbered 1-5 for its door/room (see handout_url for the numbering).

B.name: Classroom Building B
B.position: Top (north) of the horseshoe arc, directly north of Building A, next to the Portables P group.

C.name: Classroom Building C
C.position: Upper arc, east of Building B — part of the north edge of the horseshoe.

D.name: Classroom Building D
D.position: East side of the arc, between Building C (west) and Building E (east, further east).

E.name: Classroom Building E
E.position: East end of the north arc — the easternmost of the upper classroom row, closest to Grafton Street.

F.name: Classroom Building F
F.position: East-center of the arc, south of Building E and north of Building G; next to the Q portable group.

G.name: Classroom Building G
G.position: South-east side of the arc, south of Building F and north of Building H.

H.name: Classroom Building H
H.position: South-east end of the arc — the easternmost of the lower (south) classroom row, between Building G (north) and Building J (west).

J.name: Classroom Building J
J.position: South end of the arc, between Building G (east) and the Media Center (Building L); the lower south edge of the horseshoe.

K.name: Administration (Building K)
K.position: Center-south of campus, inside the horseshoe — the north half of the admin/media fan, between Building M (west) and the Courtyard (east). Visitors enter here from the main parking lot off Kohnen Way.
K.notes: Main administration offices. First stop for visitors.

L.name: Media Center (Building L)
L.position: Center-south of campus, inside the horseshoe — the south half of the admin/media fan, directly south of the Courtyard and north of the main parking lot.

M.name: Multipurpose Room / Cafeteria (Building M)
M.position: West-center of campus, just west of Building K (Administration) and east of the athletic fields.

N.name: Gymnasium / Dance Room (Building N)
N.position: West side of campus, next to the athletic fields; south-west of Building M.
N.notes: Gymnasium and dance room; the west end of the main building footprint along the athletic fields.

P.name: Portable Classrooms P1–P7
P.position: North edge of the campus, outside the horseshoe arc — a row of portable classrooms (P1 through P7) between the main arc and S Dublin Ranch Drive.
P.notes: Seven portable classroom buildings (P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7) numbered west to east along the north edge.

Q.name: Portable Classrooms Q1–Q4
Q.position: East-center of campus, outside the horseshoe arc — a row of portable classrooms (Q1 through Q4) between the arc and Grafton Street.
Q.notes: Four portable classroom buildings (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) along the east edge.

Administration Office.position: Inside Building K, in the center-south of campus. First stop for visitors entering from the main parking lot off Kohnen Way.
Administration Office.description: Main administration office — front desk, phones, visitor sign-in.

Media Center / Library.position: Inside Building L, directly south of the Courtyard.

Multipurpose Room.position: Inside Building M, west of Administration (Building K). Doubles as the cafeteria.

Cafeteria.description: Student dining in the Multipurpose Room (Building M).

Gymnasium.position: Inside Building N, on the west side of campus next to the athletic fields.

Rotunda.position: Hexagonal structure where the K (Administration) and L (Media Center) fans meet, at the south edge of the Courtyard.
Rotunda.description: Rotunda between the Administration and Media Center buildings — see the handout PDF for the exact shape.

Courtyard.position: Center of campus, inside the horseshoe of classroom buildings — the open space ringed by Buildings A through J.
Courtyard.description: Central outdoor courtyard, the gathering space inside the classroom horseshoe.

Athletic Fields.position: West side of campus: a grass sports field in the north-west and a dirt/track field in the south-west.
Athletic Fields.description: Two athletic fields on the west side of campus.

Main Parking Lot.position: South side of campus, along Kohnen Way — between the school buildings and the street. The main visitor entrance and parent drop-off.
Main Parking Lot.description: Main parking lot and parent drop-off along Kohnen Way.

navigation_notes: Cardinal orientation (verified from Google Maps satellite with the compass needle, and shown as the compass rose in the top-left of the campus_map.png): north is up. The campus is bounded by S Dublin Ranch Drive on the north, Kohnen Way on the south, Grafton Street on the east, and the athletic fields on the west.
The main visitor entrance is on the south side off Kohnen Way, through the main parking lot. Visitors should start at the Administration Office (Building K) in the center-south of the campus.

The classroom buildings (A through J, skipping I) are arranged in a horseshoe around a central Courtyard. The north/upper arc runs B → C → D → E (west to east), the east arc continues F → G → H, and J closes the south end of the arc near the Media Center.
The Administration (Building K) and Media Center (Building L) sit south of the Courtyard, forming a fan shape with a hexagonal Rotunda where they meet.
Building M (Multipurpose Room / Cafeteria) is west of K. Building N (Gymnasium / Dance Room) is further west, next to the athletic fields.

Portable classrooms P1–P7 sit on the north edge of the campus (outside the arc, between the arc and S Dublin Ranch Drive). Portable classrooms Q1–Q4 sit on the east edge (between the arc and Grafton Street).
The athletic fields fill the west side of campus: a grass sports field to the north and a dirt/track field to the south.
